verdict.rationale: Devin ships its own official MCP server (docs.devin.ai/work-with-devin/devin-mcp) that lets any MCP-compatible client create sessions, manage playbooks/knowledge, set up schedules, and query repo docs — this is distinct from Devin's client-side MCP connectivity in its CLI and represents Devin acting as the server other agents connect to. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of third-party clients successfully connecting to Devin's MCP server, and more detail on auth/permission setup for external consumers.
